If the designers want a convenience 'Jogar fora' for spoiled food, give it an in-world cost (e.g. a quick 'Limpar' chore) instead of a free Buy-mode delete.

findings.title: Accessibility: modal dialogs do not contain focus; inactive tab buttons are named only by title
findings.repro: node tools/integrate_check.mjs --clear --nohelp --wait 2500 --eval tools/qa_cr_a11y.js -> modalHasFocusTrap:false: tabbing from the Opções dialog reaches 'Girar câmera para a esquerda' behind the scrim. Buttons tab-skills/tab-career/tab-rel/tab-pers have their accessible name only via title (visible label hidden). Buy, Build and the family creator had no unnamed controls.
findings.expected: aria-modal dialogs keep keyboard focus inside them; tabs have a proper accessible name.
findings.actual: Keyboard and screen-reader users can operate HUD controls behind an open modal, for example changing speed while the game is in a 'paused for modal' state.
findings.suspected_cause: ui.js:2296-2318 openModal sets role=dialog/aria-modal but has no Tab handling and does not set `inert` on #hud/#view. ui.js:369 tab buttons rely on a CSS-hidden .t-label.
findings.suggested_fix: Set `inert` on #hud and #view while ui.modals.length > 0 (or trap Tab), and add aria-label to each tab button.
findings.root_cause: ui.js:2296-2318 openModal sets role=dialog and aria-modal=true, but it neither traps Tab nor sets `inert` on #hud/#view. aria-modal alone does not stop keyboard focus in browsers.
findings.vfix: While ui.modals.length > 0, set `inert` (or aria-hidden plus tabindex management) on #hud and the canvas container, and remove it in closeModal. Alternatively add a keydown Tab handler on #modal-root that cycles focus inside the top modal. Adding aria-label to the tab buttons is optional; they already have a computed name.

findings.title: Wallpaper applies to both faces of a wall (interior paint also repaints the exterior or the neighbouring room)
findings.repro: node tools/integrate_check.mjs --clear --nohelp --script tools/qa_bb_build2.mjs: paint the interior face of the room's back wall terracotta, then view from the north. shots/qa/bb/build2-desk-4-paper-outside-north.png shows the outside faces terracotta too. The starter house has the same limit: a wall shared by two rooms has one colour.
findings.expected: Each side of a wall has its own finish. DESIGN.md prices wallpaper as 'M$ 10/edge side'.
findings.actual: The edge stores one value 'c'. Painting a bathroom tile finish also tiles the living-room side and the house exterior.
findings.suspected_cause: js/engine.js:3456 paintWall sets one c per edge. js/render.js:761 uses one colour per edge. state.lot.walls[key] = {t,c}.
findings.suggested_fix: Store a colour per side (e.g. c for the top/left side, c2 for the bottom/right side), pick the side from the ray direction in pickEdge, and charge per side.
findings.root_cause: js/engine.js:3456 paintWall stores a single c per edge. js/render.js about line 761 colours both faces from it. js/world.js about lines 1317-1322 scores both rooms from it. The ARCHITECTURE state schema has a single c.
findings.vfix: Add an optional c2 (the bottom/right side, falling back to c), choose the side in pickEdge from the sign of the ray direction against the edge normal, charge per side, render the two faces as separate body boxes (split at the wall centre), and use c or c2 per room in computeRooms.

sim: Social variety and diminishing returns: housemates reach daily 100 / lifetime ~100 within 2–3 days and then dance or tickle 25–50 times a week (qa_simeng_scen.mjs four_empty). Add per-pair social fatigue and stronger repeat penalties for the same social, and let saturated pairs mostly 'talk' or do things side by side.

Purposeful downtime: an unemployed adult averages 3.6 h idle + 1.1 h strolling + 2.8 h lying in bed or sitting per day (qa_simeng_daymix.mjs). Let characters autonomously study or practise skills when mood is good and personality fits (serious → read/study, outgoing → mirror speech, active → workout), so skills rise and careers progress. Caio sits at Negócios L2 with performance 80 for 10 days because L3 needs mechanical 2 and he never studies.

Economy feels static: the default family's money moves under ±M$ 150 in 10 days (6500 → ~6600), so nothing new can ever be bought without heavy micro-management. Raise early pay, lower food per serving, or add small income sources (selling paintings exists but needs an easel); show a daily income/expense summary.

Fainting lasts about 11 sim-hours on the floor (energy −100 → 20 at 11/h). Wake at about −40, or carry the character to the nearest bed or sofa, so one mistake doesn't wipe a whole day (and a work shift).

New empty-lot households know 0 neighbours, and walk-bys (09–18 h) mostly happen while the resident is at work. Seed 1–2 known neighbours, schedule walk-bys when someone is home, and show a hint to buy a phone.
Throttle or merge repeated notifications (faint loops, 'Não consegue chegar lá', 'Uma refeição estragou'): the fuzz runs produced 138 'bad' toasts in a week.
When there are more household members than bed slots, add 'Dormir no sofá' and make the night fallback explicit, plus a buy-mode hint ('Falta cama para N moradores').
Cook servings only for members who are hungry (or below e.g. 60 hunger): 1–5 meals per 8 days spoil in the 2–4 person households.
Add a 'step aside' behaviour and light separation between characters so idle or waiting people make room at counters, doorways and fainted bodies (fixes SIM-7 visually).

Guests with low niceness insult and tease their hosts right after dancing and complimenting them (seed 10, qa_simeng_visitors.mjs). Limit mean socials from guests unless the relationship is already bad.
Night-shift careers: show the shift time prominently on promotion and auto-schedule a pre-shift nap with the alarm, so promotions into night shifts don't feel like a trap.
live: Clicking food on a counter or table should open the food's menu. Also highlight (outline) the object under the cursor before clicking, so players can see what will be picked.

Replace the truncated 'Aceitar vaga: …' pie entry with an offer card showing title, career, pay, hours, days and promotion path, with a compare-and-confirm step when the character already has a job. Let players accept offers from the Carreira tab list.
Add a 'Ver' button to event toasts (pizza arrived, walk-by, visitor arrived, carpool, bill, broken object) that moves the camera to the event.
Give the newspaper (new offer) and the mailbox (unpaid bills) a small glowing marker or icon. The newspaper is a tiny flat object near the street that is easy to miss.
Clicking the selected character should open a self-menu (Cancelar tudo, Ir para dentro de casa, Ver necessidades, Pensar) instead of just showing a 'selecionado' tip.
Queue strip: long-press on touch to show the action's label before cancelling, a '+N' overflow chip, and Shift-click (or long-press) to append walks while a plain click redirects the current walk.
When a character's mood is too low, show in the pie which actions are still allowed (need actions highlighted) instead of a wall of 'De mau humor demais.'
When the selected character leaves for work or the hospital, offer to switch to a family member who is at home (toast with 'Controlar Rita').
Make moving characters easier to target: a larger pick capsule, snapping clicks near a character to that character, and an optional 'pausar ao abrir menu' setting.
Show a 'PAUSADO' chip whenever speed is 0 (not only for buy/build/modal pauses), and make the help card dismissable with Space/Enter.
On phones, keep at most 2 short toasts on screen, place them clear of the camera cluster, and leave the rest to the bell log.
Make the Carreira tab a real progress view: tick 'Ir trabalhar de bom humor' from the current mood, show the shift countdown, and give friend-count hints.
Interior wall decor should stay visible in cutaway mode (cut only the walls that block the view), so paintings and mirrors bought for a room can actually be seen and used.
Disable or warn on a duplicate pizza order and show a delivery ETA chip ('🍕 chega às 10:05') near the clock.
build: Add a Room tool: drag a rectangle to raise all 4 walls at once, optionally floored. The empty-lot house took 6 separate drags plus a floor drag.

Add Undo (Ctrl+Z, and a toolbar button on touch) for the last Buy/Build action this session. Mis-clicks on walls, floors and expensive objects can currently only be fixed by demolishing at 50% refund.

Show the effect on Ambiente in the placement tip, e.g. 'Palmeira de vaso · M$ 150 · Ambiente +6 neste cômodo'. Do the same for floors and wallpaper. The room score does change (living room 4 → 10 with a palm → 16 with marble), but the player never sees it.
Shift-click with the floor or wallpaper tool fills the whole room under the cursor.
In Buy mode, raise the walls automatically (or the wall under the cursor) while placing or selecting wall items, so paintings and mirrors on camera-facing walls are visible.
Add 'Comprar outro igual' and eyedropper buttons to the selected-object toolbar, and show the object's interactions and ratings there.

When a new family moves to an empty lot, show a checklist (cama, geladeira, fogão/balcão, vaso, chuveiro, porta). Optionally offer a small prefab starter-house template. Without a bathroom door, bladder reaches −100 within hours.
Make rotation (R / Girar) pivot around the cursor tile. Near lot edges the ghost currently shifts off the cursor after rotating clamped 2x1 objects.
On touch, show a bold tile cursor and pulse under the ghost, and allow one-finger pan in Build mode when the tool is Door, Window or Paper. Currently any one-finger drag with Wall or Floor builds.
When some segments of a wall drag are blocked by furniture, offer to skip the whole drag instead of building a wall with gaps (the tip does count blocked segments).
In the pie menu, label the centre portrait with the actor ('Rita →') or show the target's face. Right now Rita's face sits directly above the title 'Caio Alves'.
Catalog: add sort (price/newest), a search box and an 'only affordable' filter. The 'Tudo' list is 43 cards long.
visual: Lot dressing (biggest cheap look): the lot is a flat, saturated lime plane with a faint white boundary line and scattered trees. Lower the grass saturation, add large-scale tonal variation or mowing stripes, a driveway and front path, a low fence or hedge on the lot boundary instead of the hairline, flower beds and a backyard prop or two, and neighbour houses beside the lot, not only across the street.

Night mood: after fixing the light leaks, give lit rooms a soft per-room fill so the far side of a bedroom is not near-black (the bed area is almost black in shots/qa/vis/house-bed-sleep.png). Make street lamps cast light pools (they only glow), light some neighbour windows, and project window light shafts onto the lawn from lit rooms.

Noon lighting is flat and white-on-white (white tile, white fixtures, cream walls). Add a slightly lower, warmer sun at midday, cheap contact shadows (baked darkened quads or AO decals under furniture and along wall bases), and darker grout or a warmer tile so kitchens and bathrooms read.
Cutaway polish: cut door openings show white door-frame stubs that look like radiators. Draw cut doors as a threshold plus a short trim, and give wall caps a cleaner two-tone trim.

Kitchen detail: counters are flat grey slabs, each with the same tan square (looks like a placeholder decal). Add a backsplash, vary the counter props (jars, cutting board on only one counter), and give the fridge front detail that reads from more than one rotation.

Buy ghost is very faint (pale translucent green). Add a bright footprint outline, a stronger tint and a slight emissive pulse, and render it over walls so placement reads, especially on phone where it is tiny.
Phone camera: at 390px the default view shows the house at about 280px wide surrounded by lawn. Start closer on phones, and auto-frame the selected character when it is near the HUD.
Catalog thumbnails are generated one at a time while cards show emoji, so the grid is a mix of 3D and emoji for a while. Pre-render all thumbnails in idle time after boot, or bake one sprite atlas.
Characters: hair silhouettes such as Caio's flat-top read as a helmet with a box on top. Round the torso and hands slightly, and add idle fidgets so standing characters do not look frozen.
Add arrival animations: carpool and pizza or service vehicles driving in along the road, and walk-bys entering from the sidewalk ends.

Sky is never visible at the fixed 50° pitch, so the SKY palette mostly tints fog that is rarely seen. Add a subtle screen-space time-of-day gradient or vignette so dawn, dusk and night colour reaches the frame edges.
Create family → 'onde morar': replace the emoji lot cards with rendered previews of the starter house and the empty lot.
Puddles read as grey paper on grass. Use a glossy, slightly blue, low-roughness material with a bright rim.

Dirty and broken states are subtle on glass and white objects (a dirty shower is barely different). Add grime decals or flies and a stronger tint, and keep the smoke and sparks used for broken objects.
code: Conflict-safe saves (fixes CR-1/CR-3 at the root): store the savedAt of the save the session started from and compare it with the cloud doc before each write. Keep a rolling backup (morada:<slot>.bak plus a cloud 'slotN_prev' doc) before overwriting. At boot, show a 'Continuar' card naming family / day / money / time for both local and cloud when they differ.
Persist and show the active slot: boot into the last-used slot, show 'Espaço 2 · Família X' in the save chip, and add a 'Continuar' entry in Options.

Add a periodic autosave (every 2–3 real minutes while dirty) besides day change and tab hide. Mobile browsers can kill an embedded iframe without firing pagehide, and a sim day lasts 24 real minutes at 1×.

Make Delete/Backspace in Buy mode use the same two-step confirm as the toolbar, or show an 'Desfazer' toast. Right now Backspace instantly sells the selected object at a loss (ui.js:1548-1549 calls sellSelected(true)).
Bill collector as a scene, not an instant penalty: he knocks and waits a few minutes, and the player can 'Pagar agora' on him. He should re-check what is still owed (see CR-5).

Re-check interaction requirements when a queued action actually starts (pay bills, clean, make bed, water plant, repair) and silently drop chores that are no longer needed, instead of walking over to do nothing or showing errors.

Create Family: enforce or auto-distribute all 25 personality points. The 'Escolher a casa' button currently only validates names, so families can start with unspent points, contrary to DESIGN 'sum 25'.
Engine performance headroom: cache slots/rooms per object keyed by M.world.version and time-slice autonomy (one resident per tick), so 10×/30× stays smooth in large player-built houses (see CR-6).

UI bubbles: compute all simScreenPos first and then write styles (each project() call does getBoundingClientRect after the previous bubble's style write, which forces layout per bubble per frame). Use transform instead of left/top and skip writes when unchanged.
Newer-cloud-save toast: include family, day, money and when it was saved (it currently says only 'Dia 1'), and do not auto-dismiss it.

Keyboard play: add a way to reach object/character menus without a pointer (e.g. Tab cycles nearby interactables and opens the pie). Together with a modal focus trap this would make the game playable without a mouse.
